prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: a transparent animation source strip of EXACTLY SIX complete character frames in ONE horizontal row, no other rows.
Create a six-frame cute bean-eye expression animation of Cecilia for her existing desktop pet.
Input image 1 is the strict CANONICAL IDENTITY, STYLE, COSTUME and PROPORTION reference. Every frame must match this exact Cecilia: mint-green long hair, green eyes when normal, cream scalloped lace head veil and small cape, white sleeves and bodice details, navy pleated skirt with delicate cream lace hem, dark stockings and small dark shoes. Preserve the existing fine 2D anime chibi linework, soft subtle cel shading and petite proportions. Input image 2 is the existing pet atlas, for identity consistency and expression examples ONLY; do not copy its grid layout.
Composition: very wide transparent canvas, EXACTLY 6 equally spaced columns in a single left-to-right row. Each column contains one full-body Cecilia of identical drawing scale; feet on one identical baseline; all six figures fully inside their own column with generous clear gutters. Hair, veil, skirt and shoes must remain complete and uncropped. No overlaps, no duplicate partial character, no background.
Sequential frames, left to right:
1. Normal forward standing pose, gentle mouth and normal open green anime eyes, hands relaxed.
2. Same body and outfit, replace only facial eyes with TWO TINY ROUND DARK GREEN DOTS (bean eyes), small round o mouth, a little innocent surprise; shoulders slightly lifted.
3. Bean eyes and tiny o mouth maintained; head gently tilted to her left, puzzled and adorable; hands lightly close together in front.
4. More exaggerated bean-eye surprise: two small circular dark green eyes spaced wider, tiny round o mouth, soft cheek blush, shoulders raised with little hands near upper chest. Expression drawn independently, do NOT scale the entire person.
5. Cute relief smile, both eyes closed as soft smiling arcs, tiny warm smile, shoulders relax; hands relax in front.
6. Return to the precise normal neutral open-green-eye expression and standing pose of frame 1 for a clean loop.
Keep calm small motion only; head/body design scale consistent. The face changes through independently drawn expression details; do not squash, enlarge or shrink the whole character. Long hair follows the tiny head tilts naturally.
Actual fully transparent background with clean alpha edges. No frame numbers, captions, letters, exclamation symbols, stars, floating icons, props, scenery, borders, checkerboard drawing, ground shadow or other characters. Six figures, one row, sprite source strip.
